name: cloudblazer_gains_two_and_draws_two
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you gain 2 life and draw two cards.' Seat 0's library holds Card A on top of Card B on top of the fillers. Cloudblazer enters: seat 0 gains 2 life and draws two cards, A and B; the opponent draws nothing and gains nothing.
